page_data.title: Creep (Radiohead song)
page_data.summary: "Creep" is the debut single by the English alternative rock band Radiohead, released on 21 September 1992. It appeared on their debut studio album, Pablo Honey (1993). Radiohead had not planned to release "Creep", but their producers liked it and encouraged them to record it. Initial sales were slow, but it became a worldwide hit after its reissue in 1993.
